nav.theme_tooltip: Switch theme (cycle through built-in theme packs)
theme.section_subtitle: Theme changes apply instantly; click "Save" to write to config
language.label: Language
language.restart_hint: Restart the app after switching language for it to take effect
login.bili.qr.hint:
Scan the QR code below with the Bilibili app.
If the QR expires, click "Refresh QR" to generate a new one.
login.bili.qr.scanned_confirm: Scanned — tap "Confirm login" on your phone
login.bili.import.title: Import from a Netscape-format cookie file
login.bili.import.hint:
Use cases: scanning is inconvenient, you already have a cookie, or you want to back up your session when Bilibili's risk control is strict.
Install the "Get cookies.txt LOCALLY" extension in Chrome/Edge/Firefox, export the Netscape-format .txt file from passport.bilibili.com, then pick it here.
login.bili.settings_detail: Click "Login" to open the Bilibili login dialog with QR code + cookie import tabs. "Import cookie file" is a shortcut to the same importer.
login.dy.hint:
Scan the QR code below with the Douyin app.
The QR is captured from the Douyin web login page (rendered by a headless browser in the background).
login.dy.status.qr_ready: QR ready — scan it with the Douyin app
login.dy.checkbox.headed_tooltip:
By default we run headless in the background and only show the QR here.
If Douyin's anti-bot rejects the headless session (QR fails to load or the scan doesn't register), check this box to restart in headed mode — a separate Chromium window will appear.
login.dy.fail_with_hint:
Login failed: {error}
If this keeps happening, check "Show browser" to retry in headed mode.
login.dy.settings_detail: From M6.26: login runs a headless Chromium in the background; only the QR from the Douyin web login page is shown here. The cookie is written automatically when login succeeds. If it keeps failing, check "Show browser" inside the dialog to retry in headed mode.
login.dy.sms.hint: Douyin requires a second-factor SMS check for this login. Enter your phone number and we will send a 6-digit code.
login.dy.sms.error_invalid_phone: Enter a valid 11-digit CN mobile number (1[3-9]xxxxxxxxx).
login.dy.sms.error_invalid_code: Enter the 4–8 digit code from the SMS.
login.dy.sms.error_empty_response: Empty response from server — please retry.
login.dy.sms.error_rate_limited: Rate limited — please wait and try again.
login.dy.need_sms_verify: QR scan succeeded but Douyin requires a phone verification step. Click here to continue →
